Synthetic WFS 2.0 GML pages for the EGiB connector tests (`tests/unit/test_egib.py`).

They have the structure of a `ms:dzialki` response (`numberMatched`, `numberReturned`, `wfs:member`) but the
geometries and parcel identifiers are invented. Replace them with a real response once the first live run has
been captured; the attribute names are still unverified (see `docs/SOURCES.md`).
